title: 1 in 8 cancer cases worldwide are caused by infections, study finds
summary: A global study reveals that approximately 1 in 8 cancer cases worldwide are caused by infections, highlighting the significant role that pathogens play in cancer development and the importance of prevention strategies.
problem_solved: Quantifies the global burden of infection-related cancers to inform public health policy and prevention efforts.
why_valuable: Provides critical data for healthcare systems to prioritize infection prevention and vaccination programs as cancer control strategies.
